items.quote: In terms of absolute numbers, Ashokji, if I tell you we can save roughly INR1.5 crores to INR2 crores per annum by moving to a lower cost location.

items.statement: Current order book roughly 25 days; defense order book ~INR1 crore
items.quote: Presently, our order book would be roughly 25 days.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improvement of ~150 bps expected from new plant
items.quote: Even the EBITDA would go up by roughly 150 basis points.

items.statement: Import duty on Chinese hook and loop imports is 10%
items.quote: Presently it is 10%. The basic duty is 10%.

items.statement: Export share targeted to increase from 15% to 20-25% of turnover
items.quote: Export presently is 15% of our turnover which is likely to go up to 20% or 25% of our turnover going forward.

items.statement: Value-added products contribute ~INR38 crores of total sales
items.quote: And the value -added figures would be roughly coming to roughly INR38 crores of our total sales.

items.statement: No PLI participation due to INR100 crore minimum investment threshold
items.quote: No, the government has announced PLI in technical textiles, but the minimum investment in that is around INR100 crores.

items.statement: Two facilities to be merged at new location by year-end; Navi Mumbai buildings valued at INR23-24 crores
items.quote: Today the valuation would be in excess of INR23 to INR24 crores for the facilities, the two buildings what you mentioned in Navi Mumbai.

items.statement: Dahej land disposed; new greenfield site being finalized
items.quote: We disposed of that facility and we are now looking at some place which is more nearby.

items.statement: NSE listing not currently possible; net worth ~INR50 crores, equity base INR7.89 crores
items.quote: One is the network and one is the equity base of INR10 cror es. So, we are at INR7.89 currently. So, to make it 10 there has to be some equity infusion and the net worth has to be 75. Currently, we are at near about INR50 crores of net worth

items.statement: Defense sector contributed ~7% of FY24 revenue
items.quote: Defense contributed to roughly 7%.

items.statement: Top 10 clients contribute ~15% of revenue
items.quote: Top 10 would be around 15%, you can say roughly.

items.statement: Expect 14% to 17% revenue growth in FY25 with strong operating leverage
items.quote: We expect a robust performance in FY '25 and achieve 14% to 17% revenue growth with strong operating leverage.

items.statement: Project mid-teens revenue growth with decent operating leverage for subsequent periods
items.quote: For subsequent periods, we expect the revenue to grow in the mid -teens range with decent operating leverage.

items.statement: No major investments needed in foreseeable future after last 2-3 years investment cycle
items.quote: the investment cycle that we had of last 2 or 3 years so that we do not need to make investments in the foreseeable future

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved to 9.7% in FY24 from 8.4% in FY23, 130 bps improvement
items.quote: On an annual basis, EBITDA margin improved to 9.7% from 8.4% in FY '23, reflecting 130 basis points improvement.

items.statement: Excluding Germany, EBITDA margin was 12.3% in FY24 vs 10% in FY23
items.quote: Excluding Germany, EBITDA margin for full financial year was 12.3% versus 10% in FY '23.

items.statement: Expect continued EBITDA margin improvement going forward with strong operating leverage
items.quote: We remain confident that EBITDA margin will continue to improve going forward.

items.statement: Ideal World and Mindful Souls acquisitions generated ~$17M revenue in FY24 (6 months)
items.quote: Mindful and Ideal World was roughly around $17 million, both of the new acquisitions.

items.statement: Expect $40M to $45M revenue from new acquisitions in FY25 at full year run-rate
items.quote: It will be between $40 million to $45 million.

items.statement: US macro indicators positive driving consumer demand; UK consumer spending subdued due to high rates
items.quote: In the U.S., macro indicators like employment data, consumer confidence, inflation rates are trending positive and driving consumer demand. Also during last year, the mix of e-comm sales to total retail sales in U.S. has improved by 90 basis points. In the U.K., inflation continues to moderate every month, but consumer spending power remains subdued due to high interest rates.

items.statement: Digital revenue share at 39% in FY24, targeting 50% by FY27; lifestyle products at 30% targeting 50% by FY28
items.quote: The digital business accounts for 39% of total revenue . Mindful Souls is anticipated to drive long-term growth, and we believe that this strategic move will lead us to 50% digital revenue share by FY '27. The sales mix of lifestyle products has been growing over the years, now standing at 30% versus 12% of FY '18. Looking ahead, our goal is to elevate the contribution of lifestyle products to 50%

items.statement: ASP declined due to inventory clearance and shift from investment-driven demand; keeping guidance at similar price points
items.quote: we are not giving a guidance that we'll go back up in a higher price point because the investment-driven demand was there during last 2 years and now inflation may not be at the similar levels. So we are keeping our guidance to the similar price point for going forward.

items.statement: Election uncertainty in US and UK factored into wider 14-17% guidance range
items.quote: So that's why we have taken the wider number 14 to 17 % because of that uncertainty. So the experience has been different for different election cycles, some election cycles, we did not see any impact. Some election cycles, we did see some impact. So it's difficult to predict.

items.statement: Germany breakeven at operating level expected in H2 FY25, full year not profitable
items.quote: We're anticipating, but by the guidance that we have given for the second half, we will be breakeven at operating level, and we are anticipating that we will achieve that level. But full year, it will not be profitable.

items.statement: Unique customer base 580K as of March 2024, up 26% YoY; 465K for base business (US/UK) on TTM basis
items.quote: As of March 31, 2024, our unique customer base stood at 580,000, which is 26% higher Y -o-Y. Excluding acquisitions as well, the unique customer base has been improving quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: Germany needs 50% revenue growth from current run-rate to reach breakeven
items.quote: if I talk specifically about Germany at 50% higher than current scale, it will be neutral.

items.statement: Order intake declined 19% YoY to INR 1,319 crores in FY24; backlog fell to INR 3,309 crores by March 2024
items.quote: During the financial year, the Company booked orders worth INR 1,319 crores against INR 1,635 crores in FY 22-23. This is 19% lower in the current financial year.

items.statement: Backlog depleted from INR 3,615 crores (Mar'23) to INR 3,309 crores (Mar'24) due to slower FGD and Hydro order flow
items.quote: The backlog thus has depleted from INR 3,615 crores as of March '23 to INR 3,437 crores as of December '23 and further went down to INR 3,309 crores as of March '24.

items.statement: Revenue declined 9.5% YoY to INR 1,625 crores in FY24; Q4 revenue grew 13.6% YoY to INR 391 crores
items.quote: Revenue in FY'24 stood at INR 1,625 crores, down from INR 1,796 crores in FY'23. This is 9.5% lower in the current financial year.

items.statement: FY24 loss before tax narrowed to INR 177 crores from INR 324 crores in FY23 due to one-time insurance and claim recoveries
items.quote: Further, the loss before tax in FY'24 stood at INR 177 crores, against loss before tax of INR 324 crores in FY'23. The reduced loss is due to one-time positive impact of insurance and customer claims.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 profit before tax was INR 23 crores vs loss of INR 128 crores in Q4 FY23, driven by INR 70 crores insurance and claim recoveries
items.quote: Profit before tax for Q4'24 was INR 23 crores, against loss before tax for Q4 '23 of INR 128 crores. Further, the loss before tax in FY'24 stood at INR 177 crores, against loss before tax of INR 324 crores in FY'23.

items.statement: Company will focus on services, brownfield FGD on EP basis, Durgapur factory utilization, pressure vessels/cryogenic equipment, and selective Hydro PSP projects
items.quote: The business areas that the company will continue to focus on is the services, which includes the core services, and service upgrades for these power plants. The company will continue to focus on brownfield FGD on EP basis.

items.statement: Reporting segments will change from July to track strategic areas: downstream FGD equipment, Durgapur factory utilization, Hydro selective participation
items.quote: But if the services growth -- the downstream FGD equipment, the Durgapur factory utilization in Hydro selective participation. So those segments is what we will report to give you progress on how we developed quarter-on-quarter in the coming quarters from July.

items.statement: Core services grew 40% YoY in FY24 with upswing in upgrade orders including DeNOx deals for Hindustan Zinc and Maithon Power
items.quote: The core services continue to grow 40% with an upswing in upgrade orders, which include major DeNOx deals like Hindustan Zinc and Maithon Power Limited.

items.statement: FGD ordering delayed; ~17 GW ordered in FY24, ~20 GW in FY23; 96 GW remains to be ordered over 4-5 years in staggered fashion
items.quote: Roughly, we see about 20 - 25 gigawatt will be ordered every year.. Ordering will take place, but in a staggered fashion.

items.statement: Booked Jaypee FGD order worth INR 775 crores for Bina and Nigrie plants on EP basis (equipment supply, erection; civil excluded)
items.quote: So that order we have booked from Jaypee. It is for the Bina and the Nigrie plants. And as we were talking about, it's going to be on EP basis. We are going to do a complete supply of the FGD equipment, erection and civil is excluded from our scope. The value is about INR775 crores.

items.statement: Durgapur factory capacity reduced from 800,000 hours to 240,000 hours; current load 80,000-100,000 hours; under-recovery INR 12-14 crores
items.quote: So we did disclose another in the cryogenic area or in the pressure vessel area where we had the first order a couple of quarters ago. And that is an area that we think will help us utilize the factory in Durgapur and it matches the capability that we have.

items.statement: Breakeven revenue for current cost structure is INR 2,000-2,500 crores; current revenue far below breakeven; sustainable margins several quarters away
items.quote: The breakeven revenue for the today's structure of the company is in the range of INR2,000 crores to INR2,500 crores, and we are far below that at this point in time, which is a challenge for the company.

items.statement: Trade receivables INR 1,699 crores as of March 2024; retention money INR 1,170 crores expected to be recovered over 2-3 years
items.quote: So out of the total that we have, that we mentioned, we have a retention of close to INR 1,170 crores. And the likelihood of realizing or recovering this money, which is linked to the various project milestones that we have.

items.statement: Order book 70% projects (FGD & Hydro), 30% services/upgrades; ~50% of backlog is slow-moving (mainly Hydro); Saundatti project INR 850 crores under suspension
items.quote: So to summarize about 50% is a slow-moving backlog, some of that is even slower but that's roughly more than 50% is slow-moving.

items.statement: Net worth fell to INR 57 crores (Mar'24) from INR 226 crores (Mar'23); company dependent on promoter for working capital limits; 3 consecutive years of losses
items.quote: The net worth of the company has come down to almost INR57 crores as of March 2024 from INR226 crores in March 2023, and the company has been making losses for 3 consecutive years.

items.statement: FGD implementation deadline approaching; slower order flow over past 2 quarters; market expects further deadline extension; ordering dependent on regulatory decisions
items.quote: The data for FGD technology where we see the government deadline for implementing the FGD for thermal power plants is fast approaching. However, we see slower than anticipated flow of orders over the past 2 quarters.

items.statement: FGD market: major players BHEL, L&T, MHPS; GEPIL targeting EP deals with cash-accretive terms; not participating in EPC bids for state utilities
items.quote: And what is remaining is about 96 gigawatt, which is to be ordered. So that is what is remaining right now. And I don't want to give a, exact number We till 2020 have been quoting on a full EPC basis. But now we are going to focus on EP deals.

items.statement: Services market ~INR 5,000 crores annually; GEPIL has low double-digit/high single-digit share in core services; technology advantage in upgrades (DeNOx)
items.quote: So the market what we are looking annual market, typically, we are looking at about INR5,000 crores. That is the number which we are estimating.

items.statement: Cannot participate in new coal BTG market without new promoter/depromoterization due to parent company guarantee requirements and promoter's global exit from new coal
items.quote: And therefore, in the current context for the company to be able to participate in new coal would only be subject to a new promoter or depromoterization where we have a new promoter back in the balance sheet to be able to participate in this market.

items.statement: Hydro PSP projects face permitting/regulatory approval delays; pipeline building but conversion to real orders takes time
items.quote: Even the new opportunities, there are a lot of permitting and other regulatory approvals requirement, which also takes time to convert it into real orders.

items.statement: India power demand grew 7% YoY for second consecutive year; peak demand 240 GW; generation 1,700 BU (76% thermal); coal production CAGR 8% over 4 years
items.quote: In the Energy sector, we are observing a positive trend with energy demand showcasing a 7% growth for the second consecutive year -- quarter, reaching a peak demand of 240 gigawatts last year.

items.statement: IEA projects 6.5% annual electricity demand growth for India 2024-26; coal production reached 997 MMT in FY24 (11.65% YoY); imports up 7.2% to 244 MMT
items.quote: According to data from IEA, with rapidly expanding economy and heightened electrification, India is projected to experience a 6.5% annual growth in electricity demand between '24 and '26.

items.statement: FGD prices have increased; government acknowledged price hikes; regulated market requires tariff revision approval and developer financial closure before ordering
items.quote: The realization for FGD price, Vinit also mentioned earlier in the call, the prices have gone up, and the government has also acknowledged and noted the prices have gone up.

items.statement: Durgapur factory underutilization costs INR 12-14 crores; target to increase utilization to 150,000-200,000 hours to eliminate under-recovery
items.quote: The amount of under-recovery presently based on the projections that we are giving is in the range of about INR12 crores to INR14 crores.

items.statement: No M&A discussed; strategy focused on organic derisking via EP model, services growth, and industrial diversification
items.quote: We have been reporting quarter-on-quarter the performance in the 3 areas. That is one, we wanted to derisk new build, which is EPC versus EP. That is one lever that we will report in every quarter.

items.statement: Other income INR 79 crores in Q4 FY24: ~75% insurance claims (Sipat/Solapur fires), rest customer claims for extension of time; some provision write-backs on export incentives
items.quote: So this is coming from claims. The insurance claim and customer claims, pretty much, it's about -- I would say 75% is coming from the insurance claims, and the rest is the customer claims for extension of time and conservation.

items.statement: Credit growth target for FY25 is around 13%
items.quote: We are targeting around 13% growth in credit.

items.statement: Capital sufficient for 13-14% credit growth for next three years without additional capital
items.quote: If we grow at 13, 14% for next three years at least, for that growth, my capital is sufficient. I do not need any additional growth capital to grow at the rate of 13% in credit for next three years.

items.statement: Board approved Rs 5,000 crore equity raise; likely in H2 Q2 or Q3 FY25
items.quote: We have already taken board approval. I think it missed out from your attention. It came all over in the ne wspaper also. Rs 5,000 crores we are going to raise. The board has already approved. And we are in the process of getting all other approvals. And that is the plan. Maybe later half of Q2 or Q3 we will be raising that

items.statement: Government holding to dilute from 96% to ~82% via Rs 5,000 crore equity raise in FY25
items.quote: Sir for the government holdings of 96% we have started the process. And in this year, we are planning to raise Rs 5,000 crore rupees of Equity and the dilution that will happen so the government holding can come down to about 82% that is what we are expecting.

items.statement: Cost of deposits targeted below 5%; full year FY24 at 4.70%
items.quote: Cost of deposit, we will try to keep it below 5 only. It is at 4.88. For the full year, it is 4.70. So, around this range only, we will try to keep it.

items.statement: GNPA down 51.72% to Rs 6,794 crore (3.10%); NNPA down 62.74% to Rs 1,217 crore (0.57%)
items.quote: Gross non-performing advances reduced by 51.72% over previous year it is at now Rs 6,794 crores reducing 434 bps over previous year and stood at 3.10%. Similarly, net NPA reduced by Rs 62.74 % to Rs 1,217 crores and percentage terms reduced by 126 bps and stood at 0.57%.

items.statement: PCR improved to 96.85%; PCR excl. technical write-off improved to 82.09%
items.quote: Provision coverage ratio improved from 92.63 to 96.85 regis tering an increase of 422 bps. PCR excluding technical write off also improved from 76.79% to 82.09

items.statement: Slippage ratio reduced 200 bps to 0.87%; slippages fell to Rs 1,516 crore in FY24 from Rs 4,029 crore in FY23
items.quote: Slippage ratio reduced by 200 bps from 2.87% to 0.87%. Slippages for FY22-23 was Rs 4029 crore, now it is reduced to Rs 1516 crore during FY23-24.

items.statement: Corporate-RAM mix shifting to 34-35% corporate, 65-66% RAM from current 27-73 split
items.quote: No, we have already taken a call. We have done a lot of study and we are shifting gear as far as RAM and corporate mix is concerned. So corporate RAM we are targeting around 65-66%. And corporate from 30% we are going to increase to around 34-35%.

items.statement: IT and digital spend approval increased to Rs 1,650 crore for FY25 from Rs 1,100 crore in FY24
items.quote: Last year data I remember, last year we tar geted to spend around Rs 1,100 crores on digital and IT infrastructure and digital software hardware including everything capital and revenue. And this year the approval which we have got from the board is around Rs 1,650 crores. Around 50% spend we have increased on IT and digital infrastructure

items.statement: Q4 credit growth appeared muted due to Rs 5,000 crore prepayment of low-yield corporate loans; growth to recoup in coming quarters
items.quote: What happened around Rs 5,000 crores of credit which was lent on a lower rate of interest or some negotiation was happening, that was paid back. So that is why Q4 because of this Rs 5,000 crores coming back into the system, the growth appears to be muted but otherwise growth was there. Ashok Ajmera: So now in the coming quarters that will be recouped

items.statement: Onboarded 25 lakh new CASA customers in FY24 with Rs 10,000 crore CASA balance
items.quote: Last year, we have onboarded around 25 lakh new customers as far as CASA is concerned. And in those newly onboarded 25 lakh customers, we are having a balance of around Rs 10,000 crores CASA balance as on date.

items.statement: Tax regime shift from old to new expected around FY28; DTA of Rs 5,300 crore to be written off by then
items.quote: May be around Year 2027- 28 we will be shifting.

items.statement: No significant regulatory remarks; legacy inter-branch reconciliation entries from 2015-16 CBS migration being resolved
items.quote: As far as I OB is concerned, we are absolutely safe. The regular inspection and oversight happens from all regulatory authorities. And there is nothing, I will say, any significant remark or observation from the auditors or the regulators.

items.statement: Disputed tax liabilities sub judice; bank has solid grounds and is pursuing appeals
items.quote: Yeah, because, it is still sub judice, and whatever claims, have been raised, we have gone for, appeal against that. And we are having, very solid, reasons to justify, th at why, this tax demands are, are not, required, I will say.

items.statement: CASA ratio improved 16 bps to 43.90%; absolute CASA at Rs 1,26,000 crore
items.quote: CASA grown in absolute terms to Rs 1,26,000 crores and also in terms of percentage, 16 bps increase to 43.90% over previous year.

items.statement: RoA improved 13 bps to 0.81%; RoE improved 69 bps to 16.24%
items.quote: Return on assets improved by 13 bps over the previous year and that is at 0.81% of total assets. Return on equity improved by 69 bps over the previous year at 16.24%.

items.statement: Cost-to-income ratio rose to 56.32% due to wage revision; would be ~44% excluding superannuation impact
items.quote: Cost to income ratio increased from 51.94% to 56.32% mainly due to increase in staff cost. Without considering the increase in superannuation benefits on account of bipartite settlement, the cost to income ratio would have been lower at around 44%.

items.statement: Sold Rs 1,842 crore assets to ARCs (NARCL and others) for Rs 660 crore consideration; Rs 161 crore provision reversal
items.quote: Both. It includes NARCL also, and other ARCs also.

items.statement: Employee cost jumped to Rs 2,517 crore in Q4 FY24 due to wage revision, terminal dues, pension, gratuity provisions
items.quote: Everything we booked in Q4 only and it was not only increase in wage but terminal dues also, pension, gratuity, requirement arising out of this wage revision for future payment that also have impacted into that.

items.statement: Dummy interest (interest on NPA recovery) constitutes 10-12% of interest income
items.quote: Around 10 to 12 percent, I think.

items.statement: Projecting at least 25% year-on-year earnings growth in FY25
items.quote: Given our momentum and the yet -to-be-unlocked value from the two acquisitions we completed in FY’24, we are optimistic a bout FY’25. There is so much growth potential, and we are comfortable forecasting at least a 25% year-on-year growth in earnings in FY’25

items.statement: Expecting 2-3% consolidated margin improvement in FY25 driven by eLearning catch-up
items.quote: So, broadly you can expect with that change, given that it's a smaller proportion of the business now, you can expect a 2% to 3% improvement in margins at a consolidated level.

items.statement: Targeting eLearning margins of 25% short-term and 30% in two years
items.quote: Our goal is to get that business in the short term to a 25% margin and more on a two-year term to a 30% margin.

items.statement: Intangible assets under development increased by ~INR 62.5 crores due to purchase price allocation for AJE and Liberate acquisitions
items.quote: So in the case of this increase is ~INR 62.5 crores which are basically ~INR 40 crores because of Liberate and the balance is coming from AJE.

items.statement: Liberate Learning expected to close its FY ending June 30 with 25% growth in order book
items.quote: After a robust 2023, Liberate had a roaring start to 2024 and is expected to close its FY, (which ends on June 30 th), with a 25% growth in order book

items.statement: eLearning order book expanded in Indian entity and pipeline looks far more robust entering FY25
items.quote: Our order book has expanded in the Indian entity, and the pipeline looks far more robust.

items.statement: Platform business launched two new SaaS products DigiCore Pro and THINK Web in FY24
items.quote: We launched two new SaaS products, DigiCore Pro and THINK Web, in FY'24.

items.statement: Platform business expects short-term revenue growth in H1 FY25 via customer migrations and remarkable growth from new customers from H2 FY25 onward
items.quote: We expect short-term revenue growth in H1 FY'25 via customer migrations from older platforms and more remarkable growth from new customers from H2 FY'25 onward.

items.statement: Eliminated ~$12 million in annual operating expenses for AJE post-acquisition
items.quote: We have already eliminated ~$12 million in annual operating expenses for AJE.

items.statement: No significant challenges anticipated in North American and European markets; only challenge in FY24 was deferred experience center project
items.quote: We are not anticipating any challenges, we have not seen anything in FY '24 as big challenges. If that changes in the second half of the calendar year, then we'll have to wait and watch. But no noise as of now.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR 45 per equity share taking total FY24 distribution to INR 75 per share
items.quote: I am pleased to share that based on the unprecedented earnings and operating cash flows in FY'25, the Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of INR 45 per Equity Share of INR 10 each of the Company. This final distribution takes the total distribution in FY24 to INR 75 per equity share of INR 10 each of the Company.

items.statement: Another acquisition target north of $20 million revenue active but timing closer to end of calendar year 2024
items.quote: When we were announcing the AJE acquisition, we had described that there's another one that's north of $20 million in Revenue that we're working on. So that's still active. It's not something that has gotten d ied or anything. It's just that the timing of that is going to be closer to the end of this calendar year

items.statement: Platform business profits grew ~30% in FY24 on consolidated basis including AJE
items.quote: On an FY basis, profits grew by as much as 30% in our platform business on a consolidated basis, including AJE.

items.statement: Revenue growth expected to be higher than profit growth in short term due to AJE acquisition integration
items.quote: In the short term, probably our revenue growth will be higher than our profitability growth simply because we acquired a loss-making AJE.

items.statement: Guidance given in May instead of October carries conservatism; management acknowledges level of conservatism in FY25 earnings guidance
items.quote: If I have to give the guidance in May instead of October I'm going to get more conservative and that's what it is.

items.statement: Annual EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 11% plus minus 50 basis points with bias towards higher end for FY24-FY25
items.quote: we would like to maintain our annual EBITDA margin guidance of 11% plus minus 50 basis point range with a bias towards higher end.

items.statement: FY25 sustaining capex INR450-500 crores and project capex INR850-900 crores including 2W alloy wheel expansion approved today
items.quote: For FY '25, the sustaining capex is expected to be around INR450 to INR500 crores and project capex of around INR850 to INR900 crores including the expansion of 2-wheel alloy wheel project approved today.

items.statement: EV order book increased from INR3,300 crores to INR3,700 crores with large part from existing EV-agnostic businesses across all EV players
items.quote: the EV order book, the large part of the orders which we have secured in the last quarter is primarily from the existing businesses, which are the EV agnostic businesses, while they are from all the EV players

items.statement: Q4 EBITDA benefited by roughly INR30 crores from yearly price increase settlement with customers
items.quote: If I have to quantify that impact, that is roughly around INR30 odd crores during the quarter.

items.statement: Customer guidance for FY25 volumes: PV segment 5-7% growth, two-wheeler segment 7-10% growth
items.quote: they tend to be a little low in PV segment, which is 5% to 7% and for two-wheeler segment, it is 7% to 10%.

items.statement: Four-wheeler alloy wheel capacity at 390,000 wheels/month running at almost 100% utilization; 60K expansion at Bawal delayed with 30K expected in H2 FY25
items.quote: Four-wheeler alloy wheel capacity stands at 390,000 wheels per month which is running at almost 100% utilization. The 60K expansion at Bawal is delayed with 30K expected to commission in second half of FY25

items.statement: Greenfield 4W alloy wheel plant at Kharkhoda 120K wheels/month in two phases of 60K each; first phase expected by Q2 FY26
items.quote: We started construction for 120K wheel per month Greenfield plant at upcoming auto hub IMT Kharkhoda which will be commissioned in two phases of 60K each. The first phase is expected to be commissioned by Q2 FY26.

items.statement: 2W alloy wheel expansion of 2 million wheels/year approved with INR300 crores investment taking total capacity to 7.5-8 million wheels/annum
items.quote: the board has also approved capex of INR300 crores for expansion of 2-wheel alloy wheel plant at Supa to add capacity by another 2 million wheels per year. This will take the total capacity to roughly 7.5 to 8 million wheels per annum.

items.statement: 95% of commodity price changes passed through to customers via annual/quarterly/half-yearly price escalation clauses in contracts
items.quote: on a full year basis, almost 95% gets passed through to our customers. So that is not any concern for us.

items.statement: Lighting business four-wheeler margins below average due to high bought-out electronic component content as kit value moved from halogen to LED
items.quote: the margin in the four-wheel lighting business specifically, which is seeing that kind of growth is below average margins, which continues to be there.

items.statement: Sensor and controller business combined revenues INR775 crores in FY24; management targets 15-20% growth assuming industry volumes support
items.quote: I would definitely like to work on 15%-20% kind of growth assuming the industry volumes also support.

items.statement: StarCharge TLA signed for EVSE manufacturing; detailed project report under preparation with better clarity expected by end of Q1 FY25
items.quote: by end of next quarter, I think we will have much, much, much better clarity because we have just signed the TLA and the team is in process of preparing the detailed project report.

items.statement: Merger of Kosei entities with Uno Minda: NOC from stock exchanges received, NCLT hearing in first week of August, completion expected in 2-3 months post hearing
items.quote: We have also moved the application to NCLT. The next date of hearing is in 1st week of August and we expect that post the hearing it will take another 2-3 months for merger process to get complete.

items.statement: Net debt INR1,318 crores as of March 31 2024 vs INR1,078 crores previous year; net debt to equity 0.25x; ROCE 19.8% including land bank and CWIP
items.quote: Our net debt as of March 31 was at INR1318 crores compared to INR1078 crores as on March 23. The net debt has increased on account of expansion capex as well as expenditure for land banks primarily at Pune and Hosur for around INR220 crores.

items.statement: Expect double-digit top line growth across all segments for current financial year
items.quote: Going forward, for current financial year, we expect double -digit top line growth across all segments.

items.statement: Plywood segment likely to grow nearly 10% with EBITDA margin 12% to 14%

So I think we are still there, not far. We're probably number 2 in that lot ri ght now. But I think to sustain something beyond 14, 15 is would be a challenge for anybody else

items.statement: EHV JV order book INR 280 cr confirmed + INR 190 cr L1 pending
items.quote: we have confirmed orders of close to INR280 crores at the beginning of April. Besides the confirmed orders, there are also orders worth about INR190-odd crores, where we are L1, but because of the code of conduct, which was announced, the power contract has not yet been signed.

items.statement: Capex program INR 500 cr, INR 160 cr spent in FY24, balance in FY25
items.quote: Yes, we had announced a program of INR500 crores. Last fiscal, we spent 160 out of that. So the balance would be spent largely in this fiscal. There might be a small spill over to '25, '26.

items.statement: E-beam first machine installed, testing; second machine June; products in 6-8 weeks
items.quote: the first machine has been installed and is current ly being tested before commissioning. The suppliers, engineers are currently working on the final testing, post which we will have to call the people from the ARC to give us a certification to plant. So that's one machine from -- on the E-beam side. So our -- I hope that we will have products available in the market in the next 6 to 8 weeks

items.statement: OFC preform facility target production by end December
items.quote: we still hope, and we believe that we will be ready for production some time towards the end of this calendar year. Our hope is that by end of December, we should have the first Preform out of this facility.

items.statement: Fiber capacity to double from 4 to 8 mn km in two steps
items.quote: Currently, we have fiber capacity of -- fiber ground capacity about 4 million kilometres. We will double this to 8 million in two steps.

items.statement: Cabling capacity to increase from 8 to 10 mn km, building ready
items.quote: We currently have a cap acity to cable about 8 million kilometres of fiber, we will take this up to 10 million. And the building for that is already ready

items.statement: Auto cable capacity expansion at Uttaranchal, equipment Q3, production Q4
items.quote: We expect the equipment to come in the third quarter of this year. So hopefully, from fourth quarter onwards, that capacity will also be available.

items.statement: Wire capacity utilization ~70-72%, cables <50%, OFC ~50%
items.quote: Currently, on wires, across various product lines, we are around 70%, 72%, cable to be lower. We have much more capacity than we are currently consuming. It's less than half. On OFC, like I mentioned, -- during the year, there was not much of a demand from the government side. So the capacities were ideal for some time. Currently, of course, we are somewhere around half utilizing, about half

items.statement: Price hikes ~10-11% in electrical cables during Mar-May
items.quote: I think it will totalled to about 10%, 11%.

items.statement: Copper cost pass-through with small lag, no hedging, monthly average pricing
items.quote: We do not take long positions on the metal. We are very clear that our ability to forecast a product, which metal prices would move 2 months from now, 2 days from now, 2 years from now. That is a year, yes, it is mine. So we don't take the risk on that on the record. We are very clear that the cost of the metal is a pass-through.

items.statement: New products (FMEG) revenue INR 225 cr in FY24, target INR 500 cr in 2-3 years
items.quote: The new product segments crossed INR200 crores for the first time. We ended the year with INR225 crores. And I think we are on track to reach the INR500 crores over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: Wire revenue mix: 60-65% construction/general, 10-15% auto, 10-15% industrial, balance agri
items.quote: Between 60% to 65% is wires which go into construction, which go into general usage. About 10% to 15% is automobile and other 10% to 15% is industrial, and the balance is agricultural.

items.statement: Retail billing touchpoints 120k (up from 90k), engaging 200k+ retailers
items.quote: At the end of last year, we have made a unique billing of close to 120,000 retailers, which in '22, '23 closed at just under 90,000. So there has been an improvement there. We're also tracking to see how many are these retailers buy every month, how many of them buy more than once a month, more than twice a month.

items.statement: Channel finance program non-recourse, INR 700-800 cr revenue via program
items.quote: Currently, I think about INR700 crores and INR800 crores of revenue is related is generated through that.

items.statement: Receivables 11 days, inventory 46 days, operating cash flow INR 575 cr
items.quote: We ended the year with 11 days of receivables and about 46 days of inventories. I think that's by far the best among the peers that we have. Cash flow generated from operations was about INR575 crores, higher than the INR380 crores, around INR380 that we achieved last year.

items.statement: Board recommended dividend 400% (21.5% payout)
items.quote: at the meeting of the Board on 23rd, the Board has recommended a dividend of 400%, which translates to a payout of about 21.5%.

items.statement: E-beam cable revenue potential INR 500-600 cr per year at full capacity
items.quote: in a year when -- in a full year the potential could be as high as INR500 crores to INR600 crores. So that's probably the potential that we are working on.

items.statement: EHV project execution delayed by right-of-way, multi-authority approvals, unmapped utilities
items.quote: The issue there is mo re to do with executio n of projects where, typically, you get in to issue around right of wa y, around the routes that are finally approved by various authorities that are required to sign up. So, if you are talking of, let's say, some city like Chennai or Pune even multiple authorities get involved in the approval of laying process

items.statement: OFC demand dependent on government funding and tender timing
items.quote: part of the reason is who is going to fund this yet. Government is a large tender in this area, but if they delay is spending or push the spending back by half a year then we do get these kind of abnormalities.

items.statement: Revenue guidance for FY25 is INR380-400 crores, dependent on Tier 1 GSI hiring recovery
items.quote: We expect the revenue next year to be in the range of INR380 crores to INR400 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance for FY25 is 3% to 5%, starting near breakeven and improving through the year
items.quote: We expect to see a 3% to 5% margin as we complete the year.

items.statement: Long-term organic revenue target of INR1,200 crores by FY28 at ~30% YoY growth, with inorganic growth as key component
items.quote: I think we will be on the right trajectory at 30%-odd on a year-on-year basis. But as far as inorganic is concerned, that is an important compon ent of that. And I think of our INR1,200 crores story because we have corpus available to invest on inorganic

items.statement: Long-term steady-state EBITDA margin target of 15% to 20% once critical mass is achieved
items.quote: We do expect a 15% to 20% margin. This is a business which should be 15% to 20% margin with the business mix that we have and the continued investments that we require.

items.statement: Tech:BFSI revenue mix shifted from 76:24 to 64:36 in FY24; BFSI grew 83% YoY in Q4, tech grew 5% YoY
items.quote: Our tech BFSI ratio moved from 76 :24 to 64:36.

items.statement: Recovery from -33% YoY in Q1 FY24 to +24% YoY in Q4 FY24 driven by Tier 2 GSIs, GCCs, BFSI, and India enterprise demand
items.quote: We pivoted focus from Tier 1 to Tier 2 GSIs as well as increased penetration in GCCs. We got into advanced technology training skills, and in BFSI, we increased penetration in large private banks and broad-based our offering.

items.statement: Capex for Q4 FY24 was INR91 million
items.quote: capex for the quarter was at INR91 million.

items.statement: Tier 1 GSI hiring freeze persisted for 6 consecutive quarters, unprecedented in company history including COVID period
items.quote: the technology sector has had an unprecedented reduction in workforce never in 6 consecutive quarter or ev en during COVID it was only 2 quarters

items.statement: Net cash at end of Q4 FY24 was INR7,185 million, up marginally despite dividend payout
items.quote: Net cash at the end of the quarter was INR7,185 million, and this is a small increase over INR7,179 million last quarter and INR7,157 million last year.

items.statement: Headcount reduced by 206 during FY24 as part of cost and product rationalization
items.quote: Headcount over the year has reduced by 206 and that's a part of our cost rationalization as well as product risk rationalization that we have been implementing.

items.statement: Board recommended final dividend of INR0.75 per share for FY24, in addition to interim dividend of INR0.50 per share paid in October 2023
items.quote: The Board of Directors met today and recommended a dividend of INR0.75 per share, final dividend of INR0.75 per share versus or this was in addition to the interim dividend of INR0.50 per share, which was paid in October 31 -- on October 31, 2023.

items.statement: Generative AI components added across all program portfolio; new specialized GenAI programs launched for customers
items.quote: During the year, the company introduced new specialized programs in generative AI for its customers and added generative AI components across its portfolio of programs.

items.statement: Value destruction in tech sector creates risk of wrong inorganic acquisition choices; company being selective
items.quote: There is a lot of destruction, I should say, value destruction, which has taken place in the tech sector, and therefore, one has to be careful that we don't make wrong choices.

items.statement: New CEO appointed, effective July 1st
items.quote: We recently announced the appointment of a new CEO, who will take over from 1st of July.

items.statement: EBITDA will decline in Q1 and Q2 FY25 due to Jindal Supreme de-hire, then improve sharply from Q3 FY25
items.quote: Going forward on a year -on-year basis, EBITDA will improve on a quarter-on-quarter basis because one of our rigs was de-hired on 25th of March, 2024. EBITDA for the first quarter of FY25 will decline and then towards the third quarter will improve sharply.

items.statement: If Jindal Pioneer acquisition completes in H1 FY25, earnings will rise in those quarters instead of declining
items.quote: The only caveat here in this statement is that in these 2 quarters of FY25 if we are able to complete the transaction of purchase of rig Jindal Pioneer, then earnings will rise in these 2 quarters itself.

items.statement: Jindal Supreme under refurbishment, expected redeployment by October-November 2024 at higher day rate
items.quote: One more rig Jindal Supreme, which was de-hired on 25th March, 2024 is currently under refurbishment. As soon as refurbishment is completed, we expect to deploy the rig by October or November of 2024 on a much higher day rate.

items.statement: Order book as of 31 March 2024 stands at US$ 251 million
items.quote: The order book as on 31st March 24 stands at US$ 251 million.

items.statement: Current market day rates nearing US$ 100,000; last Jindal Supreme contract at US$ 84,000-88,000
items.quote: The current rate is around nearing US$ 100,000 a day . The last that we got for Supreme was around US$ 84,000-88,000.

items.statement: Jindal Pioneer bareboat rate US$ 35,000/day in 2024, increasing to US$ 40,000/day from Jan 2025
items.quote: This contract was started in March of 2019 and it will continue into 2025. Right now it is at US$ 35,000 per day for 2024 and then from 1st January 2025 it will incr ease to US$ 40,000 per day on bareboat basis.

items.statement: Rig segment generates >90% of EBITDA; Mud Logging and Directional Drilling are minor contributors
items.quote: Majority of EBITDA is generated from the rig segment. More than 90% is coming from the rig segment.

items.statement: Regulatory approval for Jindal Pioneer acquisition pending; timeline uncertain despite all other approvals in place
items.quote: We have submitted an application in the third week of April, 24. We are following up on that application. Once approval is received, we can immediately buy it because the transaction has been approved by shareholders of both companies and we have obtained minority shareholder approval, audit committee approval, all sorts of approvals are in place, only the regulator's approval is pending.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 normalized EBITDA ~Rs 55 crore after Rs 6 crore one-time write-off from ONGC settlement
items.quote: For Quarter 4, there was only one transaction, which was one -time, that was to the extent of Rs. 6 crores, US$ 1.7 million was receivable, out of which settlement was done for US$ 0.98 million , so around US$ 0.7 million was written-off, and that was the expense that was written-off. Pritesh: So, Rs. 55 crores was a more normalized EBITDA for Quarter 4

items.statement: Q3 FY24 normalized EBITDA ~Rs 63 crore before one-time deployment expense
items.quote: So, for quarter 3 it should have been around Rs. 63 crores, but there was a one-time expense on account of deployment of the rig and that is why the EBITDA was lower in that quarter.

items.statement: Discovery-1 loan of ~Rs 80 crore due 31 May 2024 to be paid from internal accruals, reducing gross debt
items.quote: Further, one loan which was taken against security of rig Discovery-1 is due for payment on 31st May 2024, that amount of around Rs. 80 crores will be fully paid from internal accruals, thereby rapidly reducing the gross debt level of the Company.

items.statement: ONGC cancelled HPHT tender due to rate disagreements; such cancellations are rare one-off events
items.quote: These are one-off events. I think the only time in my 12 years, 13 years of experience that this has happened was when the rig market crashed in 2014.

items.statement: Newbuild jack-up rigs cost US$ 270-300M with 2.5-3 year delivery; not feasible vs acquiring Jindal Pioneer
items.quote: Like what I said a few months ago, when we had found out it was about 2.5 years to 3 years, and the price was about US$ 270 to US$ 300 million depending on the specification on the rigs that you wanted.

items.statement: Board approved Rs 43.9 cr equity infusion via preferential allotment; Rs 28.9 cr received by end-March; total net worth infusion over two years exceeds Rs 72 cr
items.quote: In the 4 th quarter the board of directors approved the infusion of Rs. 43.9 crores of equity by way of preferential allotment of equity shares and warrants. Of this Rs. 28.9 crores approximately was received at the end of March against the preferential allotment of equity shares and 25% of the warrants that were issued.

items.statement: Expect 2-3 percentage point EBITDA margin improvement over next 18-24 months, targeting 6-7% range
items.quote: I think actually 2-3 percentage point improvement on our margins should be expected over the next 18 to 24 months.

items.statement: Target mid-teens revenue growth for next 2-3 years; aim to reach double-digit EBITDA margins in 4-5 years
items.quote: I would say I think a growth in the mid-teens is something that we should be looking to achieve over the next two to three years consecutively.

items.statement: FY24 EBITDA margin 4% vs 5.9% in FY23; Q4 FY24 EBITDA margin 2% vs 7.2% in Q4 FY23
items.quote: For the year ended the EBITDA stood at 4% as against 5.9% in the same period last year.

items.statement: Timber prices rising; imported material becoming viable; expect raw material inflation for next 1-1.5 years, leveling off by 2025-26
items.quote: In terms of the future of raw material, I think timber is just going to be a scarce commodity for at least another couple of years. And I think by 2025 - 26, we'll see some leveling off....towards the end of '25, '26, we'll see some leveling off on the raw material side.

items.statement: Demand flat in Q4; MSME Act credit crunch in March impacted retail; one-time phenomenon
items.quote: The demand for our products were flat as reflected in our quarter-on-quarter revenue numbers. The overall business environment was quite subdued towards the end of the 4 th quarter for multiple reasons, in particular the credit crunch witnessed in March due to the new MSME Act that had a significant impact on the retail side of the business.

items.statement: Duro brand 80% of revenue, flat 1% growth; Tower brand 20% of revenue, grew >40% YoY; no cannibalization seen
items.quote: So, [a] the base is smaller for Tower and, you know, we have an inverted triangle in our company. In the sense that normally the lower priced product should have a bigger share in the market and the premium product tends to have a smaller share. And that's the reason why the uptake on Tower has been very strong.

items.statement: Asset-light model: contract manufacturing ~40% of revenue (~Rs 130 cr); own plant capacity Rs 265-270 cr revenue at 100% utilization, currently ~70% utilized
items.quote: Contract manufacturing currently is approximately 40% of our revenue.

items.statement: 40% industry capacity idle, mostly unorganized; competition intense but brand mitigates; working capital cycle stretched to 79 days in FY24 from 49 days in FY23
items.quote: As a result the cash conversion cycle has been increased to 79 days in FY24 from 49 days in FY23.

items.statement: Marketing spend 4.3% of sales in FY24 vs industry 3-3.3%; employee cost 10% of sales; expect both to rationalize with revenue growth
items.quote: Our marketing spend stood at 4.3% of sales. Our industry average is normally 3 to 3.3%. But we made a commitment a couple of years ago that we would be out spending to grow faster.

items.statement: Targets 20% CAGR in AUM and 20% ROE on consolidated basis
items.quote: Well, what we have been talking about is a CAGR of 20% and ROE of 20%.

items.statement: Expects ROE of 20% to be maintained in current year despite marginal NIM decline
items.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining the same ROE during the current year also.

items.statement: Expects credit cost in microfinance to decline to 1.5% as collections improve
items.quote: once we i mprove the microfinance collection, this will come down where we were talking about in 1.5% is credit cost

items.statement: Sees robust growth in gold loan continuing in coming quarters
items.quote: we expect a robust growth in gold loan also in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Borrowing cost increased 16 bps in Q4; dollar bond issued at slightly higher cost for diversification
items.quote: The borrowing cost has gone up by 16 basis points in Q4 FY '24.

items.statement: Expects slight dip in net interest margin but to be offset by better growth
items.quote: There could be a slight dip in the net interest margin, but it will be overcome because of better growth.

items.statement: Consolidated AUM at INR42,070 crores, up 18.7% YoY and 4.2% QoQ
items.quote: Our consolidated AUM for Q4 FY '24 was INR42,070 crores, representing 4.2% sequential growth and 18.7% Y-o-Y growth.

items.statement: Gold loan AUM at INR21,500 crores, up 8.9% YoY and 3.6% QoQ
items.quote: Gold loan AUM stands at INR21,500 crores, an improvement of 8.9% over the year ago quarter and 3.6% sequentially.

items.statement: Asirvad Microfinance AUM at INR11,881 crores including INR890 crores gold loan, up 18% YoY
items.quote: AUM stands at INR11,881 crores, including the gold loan of INR890 crores, which is up by 3 percentage Q-on-Q and 18 percentage Y-o-Y.

items.statement: Vehicle finance AUM at INR4,111 crores, up 69.1% YoY and 14.3% QoQ
items.quote: In vehicle finance business, we have reported an AUM of INR4,111 crores, which is up by 14.3 percentage Q-on-Q and up by 69.1 percentage Y-o-Y.

items.statement: Home loan AUM at INR1,510 crores, up 37.8% YoY and 6.7% QoQ
items.quote: The home loan business had a total book of INR1,510 crores, which is up by 6.7 percentage Q-on-Q and up by 37.8 percentage Y-o-Y.

items.statement: Non-gold business share now 49% of total AUM, in line with diversification strategy
items.quote: The share of non-gold business now stands at 49% of the total assets under management.

items.statement: Consolidated GNPA at 1.93% vs 1.99% previous quarter; standalone asset quality below 2%
items.quote: GNPA is at 1.93 percentage versus 1.99 percentage during the previous quarter.

items.statement: Asirvad net NPA at 1.71% with CRAR 22.79%; collection efficiency 98%
items.quote: Net NPA stands at 1.71 percentage, with a CRAR of 22.79 percentage. In vehicle finance business, we have reported an AUM of INR4,111 crores, which is up by 14.3 percentage Q-on-Q and up by 69.1 percentage Y-o-Y. Our GNPA is at 2.9 percentage as on 31st March 2024. The home loan business had a total book of INR1,510 crores, which is up by 6.7 percentage Q-on-Q and up by 37.8 percentage Y-o-Y. It op

items.statement: Vehicle finance GNPA at 2.9%, collection efficiency 100% in certain regions, 77% via NACH
items.quote: The GNPA there is around 2.9% and we will be able to maintain that below 3% going f orward also. The collection efficiency is 100 percentage in certain regions. And for us, we have given a lot of emphasis for CRM. And around 77% of these are collected through the NACH

items.statement: MSME GNPA rose to 1.7% from 1.5%; digital personal loan GNPA ~12% but only 1% of standalone AUM
items.quote: Yes, it was 1.5%, increased to 1.7%. And if you see the digital personal loan in the overall ratio mix, it has come down to 9 percentage. Because of the higher delinquency, we have tightened the underwriting.

items.statement: MFI PAR elevated due to Punjab and Rajasthan; collection machinery strengthened, improvement seen week-on-week
items.quote: We have some problems in some states like Punjab, Rajasthan, etc. So, there we have reinforced collection machinery. And we hope the collections will improve going forward.

items.statement: Gold loan yield at 22%; average LTV at 58%, well below peers; online book 57% of gold loan portfolio
items.quote: it is going on gold loan at 22% yield, and that is the reason it will not impact the profitability.

items.statement: Higher gold prices have minimal impact on ticket size; customers bring less gold rather than borrow more
items.quote: when the gold price goes up, they bring lesser quantity of gold. They don't simply avail a bigger amount simply because of that.

items.statement: Fully compliant with INR20,000 cash disbursement limit from 8th May 2024; online gold loan now 63% and rising
items.quote: we are fully compliant about that from the 8th of this month and we are disbursing loans of INR20,000 and above that only into the bank account or through online gold loan mode.

items.statement: No level playing field loss as cash limit applies to all regulated entities; no structural customer loss expected
items.quote: this is applicable to all the regulated entities. So, we don't lose any level playing field because of that.

items.statement: Auction surplus reduced from INR48 crores to INR14 crores over 15 years; reducing ~INR2 crores per quarter; seeking RBI permission for branch expansion
items.quote: So, the Rs 48 crore was the accrual over the last 15 years. So we have employed many other measures including different agencies etc., for repayment and that is the end result. It has been brought down now to around INR14 crores from INR48 crores and we have informed RBI about that and we hope that we'll get permission to open more branches with this.

items.statement: Cash and equivalents INR3,181 crores; undrawn bank lines INR6,000 crores; CP exposure 4% standalone; leverage 2.9x
items.quote: With regard to liquidity, cash and cash equivalents stand at INR3,181 crores and undrawn bank lines of INR6,000 crores as on 31st March 2024. Our CP exposure is 4 percentage in the standalone entity.

items.statement: Issued dollar bonds to diversify funding mix and reduce bank borrowing dependence
items.quote: We are also pursuing a strategy of diversifying our funding mix by reducing dependence on bank borrowings and opted for dollar bonds with this objective.

items.statement: Board declared interim dividend of INR1 per share for the quarter
items.quote: The Board has declared an interim dividend of INR1 for this quarter.

items.statement: Improving dividend quarter-on-quarter; capital allocation favors secured lending with 10% to unsecured microfinance
items.quote: Going forward at the same time, as you said, we are giving back also by improving the dividend quarter-on-quarter.

items.statement: Employee rationalization in gold loan due to online shift; headcount growing in non-gold business as footprint expands
items.quote: Employee rationalization is also because of more online gold loan activity. So the employee count in gold loan segment has come down while in non-gold, we are slowly expanding our footprints.

items.statement: Consolidated ROA 4.9% (up 60 bps YoY); ROE 20%; standalone CRAR 30.6%; net worth INR11,548 crores
items.quote: ROE on a consolidated basis was 20% and ROA was 4.9 percentage. Our leverage is currently only 2.9x.

items.statement: Planning capacity addition for long-term supply agreement with MNC, estimated investment ₹650-700 crores funded from internal accruals, facility expected operational by January 2027
items.quote: We are in the process of entering into a long-term supply agreement with an MNC and planning for a capacity addition with an estimated investment between ₹650 crores to ₹700 crores, which will be funded from internal accruals. The proposed facility is expected to be operational by January of 2027.

items.statement: Unit III facility near Kakinada progressing well with production expected to commence phase-wise during FY25
items.quote: Unit III facility near Kakinada is progress ing well with production activity expected to commence phase wise during financial year 2024-25.

items.statement: Capex guidance for FY25 approximately ₹1,500-1,600 crores including balance ₹800 crores for Kakinada Phase I and ₹700 crores for new MNC project
items.quote: Yes, that's the correct understanding.

items.statement: Submitted all regulatory filings for future generics; products will commercialize once off-patent starting FY25 with 1-2 molecules initially
items.quote: We have about seven molecules that we have identified, okay, which from FY '25 onwards, for the next 5 years will come off patent, some, maybe -- I mean they depend on the molecules.

items.statement: Seeing substantial increase in CS inquiries across existing clients, new MNCs, and niche companies; opportunities in Phase II/III fast-track projects
items.quote: It's a mix of everything. It's existing clients, new MNCs and also other niche product companies.

items.statement: Gross margins protected by backward integration and cost efficiency efforts despite generic pricing pressure; fair assumption of no big dip in gross margin
items.quote: I mean, I would say that is a fair assumption for now.

items.statement: Generic pricing pressure continues in regulated and non-regulated markets; difficult to predict stabilization timeline (could be 1-2 years); volumes stable with slight gains
items.quote: There is pricing constr aints across the world, we are seeing both in the regulated and nonregulated markets. It's very hard to say when this will stabilize. Sometimes it takes one year, sometimes it takes 2 years.

items.statement: Q4 FY24 product mix: Generics 49%, Custom Synthesis 51%; full year FY24: Generics 55%, Custom Synthesis 45%
items.quote: Product mix for generics to Custom Synthesis is 49% to 51% for the quarter and 55% to 45% for the year.

items.statement: Red Sea crisis causing increased freight costs and transit time extensions; implemented risk mitigation including expedited shipping and proactive communications
items.quote: The ongoing Red Sea crisis has precipitated disruptions across global supply chains. The recent quarter witnessed profound impact of the crisis globally, which manifested in increased freight cost and transit time extensions with prolonged voyages attributed due to rerouting measures.

items.statement: Expecting double-digit growth year-on-year ex-COVID products; both generics and CS growing hand-in-hand with ratio varying ±5% around 50:50
items.quote: So if you are looking at like year-on-year, we have always said we would look at a double-digit growth and that's what we've been seeing constantly.

items.statement: Targeting 18-22% CAGR in sales over next two years with better profitability CAGR due to operating leverage
items.quote: over the next two years, based on the orders in hand and the visibility thereof, we are fairly confident of delivering CAGR growth in sales of around 18% to 22%, with a better CAGR growth in our profitability numbers

items.statement: Standalone order book at INR1,956 crores as of March 31, 2024; reached INR2,000 crores landmark with April orders
items.quote: as on 31st March 2024 at a stand-alone level, we have about INR1,956 crores of orders in hand

items.statement: Booked INR472 crores orders in Q4 FY24, of which INR446 crores from defense segment
items.quote: We have booked about INR472 crores of orders in Q4, out of which close to INR446 crores of orders are from defense

items.statement: JV ARC targeting INR900 crores potential orders in coming years with 10-15% YoY growth and 10-15% PBT
items.value: 900 crores potential orders; 10-15% YoY growth; 10-15% PBT
items.quote: There is potential to bag big orders in the coming years to the extent of about INR 900 crores and will record at least about 10% to 15% year-on-year growth in the next few years with a PBT of around 10% to 15%.

items.statement: JV ARC FY25 sales target of $40 million (~INR330 crores) with INR900+ crores orders in pipeline
items.quote: Now in terms of sales, we have a plan to boo k sales of $40 million, which is about INR330 crores in FY'25. Going forward, we have a very good visibility to maintain sustainable growth with the opportunities emerging in the domain of our operation

items.statement: Incurred ~INR40 crores capex in FY24 for testing equipment; long-term debt under INR15 crores
items.quote: The capex, it is a normal testing equipment and other things which are required to support our existing activities. Basically about close to ab out INR40 crores is the capex incurred by the company in terms of these test equipment’s

items.statement: Domestic BTS margins significantly higher than historical offset export margins; new export products targeting better margins
items.quote: The margins are significantly high as compared to the exports. But as just now I mentioned that we are focusing to develop a few products and as well as systems for the global market will be our own IP so which definitely will have a better margin as compared to what we got in recent times.

items.statement: Q4 raw material cost rose to 62.6% from 53.5% in Q3 due to product mix variation
items.quote: the raw material consumption depending on the product mix. It is quite possible that some of the products that we have executed in Q4 has higher raw material costs, and that is the only reason why it would h ave gone up

items.statement: Working capital days target ~240 days but currently higher due to Q4 sales bunching, project inventory needs, and deferred receivables

items.statement: Long-term North Star target of ₹1,000 crore revenue in 6-9 years organically and inorganically
items.quote: But we have said we have spoken and agreed internally that that's the North Star at the moment that we are looking at.

items.statement: Expect margins to reach 19-20% range in 3-5 years as international services mix increases
items.quote: but absolutely, our expectation i s that if we're going to look at our margins in three to five years' ti me, they will be in the range that you are mentioning

items.statement: Service margins 22-25% in India vs 50-55% in US; product margins 16-19%
items.quote: When we work in India, our margins on services are typically in the range of 22% to 25%. But when you are working with customers, let's say, in the United States, our margins are in the range of 50% to 55% on services.

items.statement: Net new customer acquisition in US improved, now competing with SAP/Oracle/Infor for greenfield deals
items.quote: We have had some really good (customer) acquisitions and as I said, this is where we are now competing there with the likes of maybe an SAP or Oracle or Infor.

items.statement: Increasing customer interest in IPA, copilots, and data engineering driven by Gen AI
items.quote: Increasingly, more number of customers have been showing interest in exploring the IPA, the co-pilots, and the data engineering.

items.statement: Repeat plus recurring revenue 88% for FY24, 79% for Q4 FY24
items.quote: Repeat plus recurring revenue was 88% and during the year, we added 56 new customers.

items.statement: Added 56 new customers in FY24 (34 domestic, 22 international); 11 in Q4 (5 domestic, 6 international)
items.quote: During the year, we had 34 new domestic customers and 22 new international customers.

items.statement: Top 5/10 customer concentration decreased in FY24; ~250 active customers total
items.quote: I think our total number of active customers is now ~250. Now that does not mean that every customer will continue to make the same level of investment with us through the year.

items.statement: Increasing investments in US sales/presales and India sales strength; using cash for inorganic growth
items.quote: We are now deciding to increase our investments on the sales and presales side in this region. Increasingly, more number of customers have been showing interest in exploring the IPA.

items.statement: In active conversations with one data engineering company; previously paused Dynamics company talks until December
items.quote: We are currently in conversation with one data engineering company. What has not changed, the Board of Directors ... you're familiar with ... other than maybe some pictures changing on this slide.

items.statement: Headcount 360 (up from 350); attrition 7% in Q4, 16% for FY24 including performance exits
items.quote: The attrition rate during the quarter was 7%, and during the entire year, it stood at 16%.

items.statement: FY24 revenue mix: US 45.8%, Domestic 35.2%, Africa 9%, APAC 6.6%, Europe 3.4%
items.quote: Our domestic services revenue was 35.2% for the year, and the U.S. was 45.8%, Africa, 9%, APAC, 6.6%, and Europe, 3.4%.

items.statement: Microsoft Dynamics 365 grew 23%, Azure 31%, Intelligent Cloud 21% in Microsoft Q3
items.quote: So the Intelligent Cloud business for Microsoft has grown by 21% as per the results of Q3 for them. The Azure Plus business grew by 31%, and the Dynamics 365 by 23%.

items.statement: IP-led solutions carry higher margins; all IP revenue retained after R&D investment
items.quote: Yeah, absolutely. I mean, whatever we get from the IP is all for us. And, of course, we have to keep investing in building these products and keeping solutions updated.

items.statement: Short-term loans/advances increased to ₹10 crore, primarily advances to subsidiaries
items.quote: Short-term loans, I need to get into the details. So it's basically, advances given to our subsidiaries.

items.statement: Cash balance ₹115 crore; primary use for acquisitions and international growth investments
items.quote: The top of our mind, of course is acquisitions. Inorganic growth, it's certainly going to be the biggest application of those funds.

items.statement: Key risk is rising talent costs; geographic diversification provides insulation from local turbulence
items.quote: So that's one part of it. The other part of it is that, well, if we are sloppy, if we don't do our job, then anyways, anything can happen.

items.statement: Expanding consulting and sales teams in US and India; adding campus and lateral hires
items.quote: We also need to increase the strength of our consulting and salespeople on the field; and that's an area that we are increasing our investments in.

items.statement: Three revenue components: consulting, product (Microsoft + IP), implementation/support services
items.quote: When we provide a solution to our customer, it has, I would say - broadly three components. There's an initial consulting piece involved in the overall engagement.

items.statement: No specific regulatory risks mentioned; geographic spread mitigates local turbulence
items.quote: But I would say the technology business has invariably done better even in adverse situations, as I was saying and just to repeat, how we saw the reaction of the world during pandemic.

items.statement: Certified Great Place to Work; 900+ implementations; Microsoft Inner Circle awards; multi-country operations
items.quote: We were, once again, certified as a Great Place to Work. We have done in excess of 900 implementations, ... close to a 1000 now, multiple times awarded with Microsoft's Inner Circle and other awards.

items.statement: First truck rollout expected end of August to mid-September 2025
items.quote: So that means, the first truck will be rolled out, we expect that to be sometime end of August, middle of September.

items.statement: Bangalore plant capacity of 7 vehicles simultaneously with 6-week turnaround targeting 30-40 trucks annually
items.quote: Seven at a time is what we are trying to do. So, we should be able to turn around something like 30 to 40 trucks per year, approximately.

items.statement: Received order for 4 runway rubber removal machines from Airports Authority of India to be integrated at Bangalore plant
items.quote: Today, you have received an order from the Airports Authority of India, for the four runway removal machines. So, will you be manufacturing those in the Bangalore plant or…? Unnikrishnan Nair: Yes. Manufacturing in the sense, we will be integrating it

items.statement: Margins slightly reduced due to forward investment in employee costs for new manufacturing plant
items.quote: And also, there is a slight reduction in the margins that is due to we are keeping the new manufacturing plant in view. We have appointed, we had to incur the employee cost.

items.statement: Borrowing cost reduced from INR74.47 lakhs to INR36.14 lakhs by closing high-interest term loans
items.quote: And then our borrowing cost has been reduced from INR74.47 lakhs to INR36.14 lakhs. The primary reason is that the term loans which are having more than 15% interest rates, which we have closed during the year

items.statement: Cash flow from operations improved from negative INR9.27 crores to positive INR2.05 crores
items.quote: Our cash flow from operations compared to the previous year, which was negative INR9.27 crores. But in the current financial year, we have increased by INR11 crores, which is now INR2.05 crores positive.

items.statement: Current ratio reduced from 3.28 to 2.53 due to good operating collections
items.quote: Our current ratio compared to previous year has reduced due to the good operating collections, the current ratio has come down from 3.28 to 2.53.

items.statement: Incurred INR4.42 crores on factory building under capital work in progress and INR20.46 lakhs on SAP implementation
items.quote: And we have incurred INR4.42 crores towards building our factory, which was during the financial year end, which was still under final completion, which is getting completed now.

items.statement: Added grass cutting and collection machines for airfields and firefighting chemical foam distribution to product portfolio
items.quote: And last very recently, we also entered into a new field, which is the grass cutting and collection from airport, airfield areas where the grass has to be grown to keep the dust under control. We also have now entered into distributing firefighting chemical form.

items.statement: Targeting cost reduction by avoiding European labour rates (EUR63/hour) through Indian assembly using experienced local engineers
items.quote: When it comes to manufacturing and assembly, a German engineer will charge you something like EUR63 per hour for assembly. That means if we use our people who have got a good experience in repairing, in overhauling, in maintaining these components, they have been doing this now for 17 -18 years in India.

items.statement: No single competitor across full product range; segment-wise competition from OshKosh, Iveco but no domestic player with fully ICAO-compliant crash fire tenders
items.quote: Therefore, when you talk about competition, we do not have a single competitor. We have competition segment -wise. And the advantage that we have is, see, let's say, one of our competitors is an American company called OshKosh.

items.statement: Supplying pump systems to corporate office complexes in Gurgaon; participating in refinery project requiring 23 trucks where no single domestic bidder could technically or financially qualify
items.quote: One example is Gurgaon. They have implemented our pump system all through the corporate office complexes in Gurgaon. So we need to meet that if we have to bring in FDI and process their equipment.

items.statement: ICAO compliance required for airport licensing; DGCA mandates maintenance records from OEM or accredited agency for airport category renewal
items.quote: ICAO is International Civil Aviation Organization, whose compliance are required for licensing your airport. So, this is one example. It more or less applies to runway rubber removal, runway friction tester.

items.statement: Post-sale service revenue mandated by DGCA regulatory requirements for airport fire truck maintenance and certification
items.quote: For example when you sell a fire truck to an airport the statutory agency DGCA tells the customer I need to see every now and then the maintenance record of the maintenance agency which has to be either the OEM or their accredited agency.

items.statement: Management reiterates confidence in delivering 25% EPS CAGR over next 3 years, consistent with guidance since 2022 JV with Vopak.
items.quote: The outstanding performance aligns with our guidance of achieving a 25% cumulative average growth in earnings per share over the next 3 years.

items.statement: Management expects FY25 logistics volumes of 5 million+ tons and distribution volumes to grow 25% YoY.
items.quote: I think if you take the run rate of the fourth quarter for logistics volume and slight improvement on that, I think, we should achieve 5 million plus for FY '25, if all things are normal as far as all other factors are concerned. Distribution volumes, we have always said that we expect a 25% increase from here on.

items.statement: Capex plan of INR4,500 crores by FY27 on track; Pipavav and Mangalore cryogenic LPG terminals expected Q1 FY26; additional 300,000 KL liquid capacity in FY25.
items.quote: You may recall that this time last year, we have set out the capex plan of about INR4,500 crores by FY '27, almost 50% of which comprised of these 2 cryogenic LPG terminals in Pipavav and Mangalore as well as the various liquid expansions in Haldia, Mangalore, JNPT, Kandla, and Kochi, which are proceeding on time and on budget.

items.statement: Ammonia terminal at Pipavav: 36,000 MT static capacity, ~INR500 crores capex, construction to start FY25 after permits, commissioning ~24 months.
